integrity: The claim is proved analytically from the defining degree constraints. The bundled exhaustive check is a finite stress test only and is not used as a proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an equality characterization at the lower endpoint only; it does not determine values above half the order. A residual originality risk remains because the full 2021 paper establishing the sharp bounds was not available through a lawful open full-text route during comparison.
title: Equality at \(n/2\) for \((1,2)\)-domination in cubic graphs
